business_summary: Arata Corporation engages in the wholesale of daily necessities, cosmetics, household goods, pet supplies, and others in Japan. The company offers health and beauty products, including cosmetics, bath additives, body cleansing agents, hair color, oral care, pharmaceuticals, and health foods; baby products, baby diapers, nursing care products, adult diapers, sanitary products, and tissue and toilet paper; pet supplies; laundry detergents, kitchen and dishwashing detergents, and household detergents; fragrances and deodorizers, insect repellents, insecticides, incense candles, dry cell batteries, dry cell battery applications, recording media, lighting equipment, electrical applications, office automation equipment, and photographic related products; kitchen consumables, toiletries, cleaning supplies, storage supplies, seasonal products, preservation supplies, cooking supplies, tabletop supplies, and vacation supplies; and stationery, toys, car accessories. It is also involved in the retail, wholesale, and import/export sale of pets, and pet food and accessories, as well as sells pet-related products online; pet styling and grooming activities; recruiting of franchised stores; and store management activities, as well as research and development of pet shop franchise systems; operation of pet hotels; and manufacturing and sale of cosmetics. The company was incorporated in 2002 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.
